note: Views exposed filter blocks provides a single core Block plugin, id 'views_exposed_filter_blocks_block' (category 'Views Exposed Filter Blocks'), that renders a view display's exposed filter form as a standalone block placeable in any region. No configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Its only persistent state is per-block config in each block.block.<id> config entity, with two module-specific settings: view_display ('<view_id>:<display_id>', e.g. content:page_1) and form_state_always_process (boolean, default TRUE). All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real block config on the live site: introspection reads back a placed block's view_display and form_state_always_process; execution places a block for content:page_1 and verifies the plugin id + settings against the live block.block config entity. The core 'content' view (display page_1) is used as a stable target that ships with exposed filters.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I have a view whose display is NOT a page (for example an EVA or attachment display) and I want its exposed filters to appear as a separate block in a sidebar. Using the views_exposed_filter_blocks module, how do I do that and what is the block plugin called?
evals.expected_output: Enable the module and go to Structure > Block layout, click Place block, and add the 'Views exposed filter block' (plugin id views_exposed_filter_blocks_block, category 'Views Exposed Filter Blocks') in the desired region, then choose the view & display whose exposed filters to render. It works for any display plugin, not just page displays.

evals.prompt: What configuration settings does a views_exposed_filter_blocks block instance have, and what format is the value that selects which view/display's filters to show?
evals.expected_output: Two settings: view_display, a '<view_id>:<display_id>' string (e.g. content:page_1) selecting the view and display; and form_state_always_process, a boolean (default TRUE) that makes the block process submitted input on build. They are stored on the block.block.<id> config entity under settings.

evals.prompt: How does the views_exposed_filter_blocks module differ from views_block_filter_block, and which view display types does it support?
evals.expected_output: views_block_filter_block is configured on the view and only works for 'block' display plugins; views_exposed_filter_blocks is configured entirely on the block (you pick the view & display in the block settings) and works for any display plugin, including eva, page, block, and attachment displays.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a block named 'vefb_eval' placed with the views_exposed_filter_blocks module. Inspect the live block configuration and state which view and display its exposed filters come from.
evals.expected_output: block.block.vefb_eval uses plugin views_exposed_filter_blocks_block and its settings.view_display is 'content:page_1', so it renders the exposed filters of the core Content view's page_1 display.

evals.prompt: A views_exposed_filter_blocks block named 'vefb_eval2' is placed on this site. Its 'always process the form state' option has been set to a non-default value. Inspect the live block configuration and state whether that block processes the submitted form state on build (i.e. the value of form_state_always_process).
evals.expected_output: In block.block.vefb_eval2 settings.form_state_always_process is FALSE (the default is TRUE), so the block does not process the submitted form state on build; it only submits values to the results view.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the views_exposed_filter_blocks module to place a block with the machine id 'vefb_task' that renders the exposed filters of the core Content view's page_1 display. Apply the change to the live site (any region is fine).
evals.expected_output: A block.block.vefb_task config entity with plugin: views_exposed_filter_blocks_block and settings.view_display: 'content:page_1' (place the 'Views exposed filter block' and select the Content view / page_1 display, or create the Block config entity directly).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use views_exposed_filter_blocks to place a block with machine id 'vefb_task2' that shows the exposed filters of the Content view's page_1 display, but configure it so the block only submits filter values to the results view and does NOT process/display submitted values itself (turn off 'always process the form state'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block.block.vefb_task2 config entity with plugin: views_exposed_filter_blocks_block, settings.view_display: 'content:page_1', and settings.form_state_always_process: false.
